editorial:
You meet Roderick Blank just as his neat life falls apart. He is engaged, successful, and comfortable until a strange email hands him a list of every woman he has slept with and every woman he will sleep with. Instead of ignoring it, he turns the list into a mission, chasing names across town while his real life crumbles. The movie mixes dark comedy, romance, and a little danger, so you get laughs, awkward dates, and a growing sense that this game has rules he does not understand. Winona Ryder's Death Nell adds a sharp edge, making the story feel like a twisted fairy tale about desire and consequences.

The best parts are the strange energy and the way the movie keeps you guessing about who is in control. Simon Baker makes Roderick charming enough to follow, even when his choices are messy, and the pacing moves quickly from one encounter to the next. On the downside, the tone can feel uneven, and some jokes land harder than others, so you may wish it picked one mood and stayed there. If you like offbeat romantic comedies with a dark streak, this is a fun late-night pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the sharpest picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Roderick's list-chasing finally leads him to Death Nell, the femme fatale who targets men guilty of sex crimes. The twist is that his obsession has made him her next victim: she seduces him, then kills him, turning the email from a fantasy scorecard into a warning. The movie ends with the sense that treating people like names on a list has real, deadly consequences.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark romantic comedies with a twisted edge.
